set.descent_text: The traverse starts from the summit of Outpost and continues along the ridge crest over Spire to Quadrant. Spire is left by rappelling its south side, and Quadrant is descended by its standard South Ridge. The notches between Outpost and Spire can need rappels or careful downclimbing, and the rock there is loose.

review.notes: Route page, original description plus the later correction.

set.descent_text: The route ends at a summit snowfield, from which the summit of Adamant is a short way on. Rappel the route, since fixed tat marks every belay, or hike down from the summit on its west side and circle back to the Austerity Glacier.
The route ends at a bolted anchor, and the crag's bolted rappel stations serve for the way down. An easy trail or scramble also reaches the top of the cliffs.

review.notes: Route page: bolted anchor. Area page: bolted rappel stations on all routes and a trail or scramble to the tops.

set.descent_text: The crack ends at rap anchors. Descend by rappel from them.

set.descent_text: The route ends near the summit ridge of Boxcar Mountain. Walk off north across the flat summit area to meet the Boxcar Mountain trail, then follow it downhill to the Goat Lake trail. A creek in a meadow about halfway down gives water.

review.notes: Route page descent; distance left out (single source).

set.descent_text: The top is a broad grassy flat. Walk west across it to the edge above Denture Ridge, then make short rappels directly back to the pass; look for the anchors made of pins, nuts and cord.

review.notes: Route page descent; rappel count left out (single source).

set.descent_text: The chimney finishes on the summit of Grimface, after a pitch of easy cracks and a short scramble. The best way down is the west ridge, which leads back toward the Wall Creek meadows.

review.notes: Route page names the west ridge as the best descent and the summit as the top-out; the Matriarch page says that ridge returns to the meadows.

set.descent_text: The four pitches end on the summit of Matriarch. From there, carry on along the ridge traverse through Macabre to Grimface, then come down Grimface's west ridge to return to the meadow camp.

review.notes: Matriarch SW Face page states the traverse continuation and the west ridge descent.

set.descent_text: The route finishes on the summit of Grimface, after a wide crack below the top and easy face moves out to the left. Walk off toward the northwest, where cairns mark the easiest way down. Anyone camped in the meadow can also drop straight down the scree gully to camp.

review.notes: SE Notch page: top-out on summit, northwest walk-off with cairns, scree gully to the meadow.
